decisions.reason: This vertigo combination tablet launched in 2024 sits close to the firm's core Rx offer and has its own page, so its value is still uncertain while keeping it costs little given the regulatory investment already sunk.

This generic antidepressant is distant from the core offer and faces price-competitive tender markets, so it is the riskiest option, but one year gives too little evidence to abandon an approved product that can also use idle manufacturing capacity.
This multi-strength antihypertensive line fits the established portfolio and has its own page, so it is a low-cost option with growth potential that should stay open while its uptake becomes clear.
